{{Infobox|title=Poplar|invimage=Poplar Log|type=Wood type}}
'''Poplar''' is a wood type that arrived with ''Minecraft'' 26.3. The pack's resource pack textures its logs and planks, and its three autumn leaf colors: '''red''', '''orange''' and '''yellow'''. The pack gives poplar the same changes as the other wood types.

== Items ==
Poplar has the usual wooden set (see {{MCW|Poplar Log}} for the vanilla details): [[Poplar Log]], [[Poplar Wood]], stripped versions, [[Poplar Planks]], [[Poplar Stairs]], [[Poplar Slab]], [[Poplar Fence]], [[Poplar Fence Gate]], [[Poplar Door]], [[Poplar Trapdoor]], [[Poplar Button]], [[Poplar Pressure Plate]], [[Poplar Sign]], [[Poplar Shelf]], the boats and the [[Poplar Sapling]]. Its leaves come in red, orange and yellow.

== Changes from vanilla ==
* '''Stonecutter.''' Poplar logs, wood, planks, slabs, stairs, fences, doors, trapdoors, buttons, pressure plates, signs and shelves can be cut from each other in the [[stonecutter]], like the other wood types.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/poplar_planks.json}}</ref>
* '''Leaves.''' Red, orange and yellow poplar leaves follow the [[Leaves]] rule: they drop only themselves, and only when broken with [[shears]] or a Silk Touch tool, and never saplings or sticks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/yellow_poplar_leaves.json}}</ref> A poplar sapling is crafted from any one of the three leaf colors instead. The recipe unlocks when the player picks up a poplar log.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/poplar_sapling_from_poplar_leaves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/poplar_leaves.json}}</ref>
* '''Logs.''' Poplar logs and stripped poplar logs drop charcoal when mined with an adamant tool, with the [[Fortune]] and electrum bonuses, like other logs.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/poplar_log.json}}</ref>
* '''Trading.''' A level 2 [[Leatherworker]] sells 64 poplar logs for an [[obol]] and a poplar sapling.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/leatherworker/2/poplar_log.json}}</ref>
* '''Trees.''' The yellow poplar tree feature is 2 blocks taller than in vanilla (base height 9 instead of 7).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/yellow_poplar.json}}</ref>
